name: Bauhaus
description: Modernist German movement emphasizing primary colors, bold geometric forms, functional hierarchy, and asymmetric balance.
designPrinciples: Bold primary colors anchored with strong black and warm off-white
Asymmetrical composition balanced by weight and scale
Geometric foundational shapes (rectangles, circles, solid dividing rules)

guidelines: Treat typography as a structural geometric element
Keep body copy clean, concise, and unadorned

layout.structure: Asymmetrical column and card arrangement with distinct color blocks
layout.spacing: Exaggerated padding (32px to 48px) separating stark geometric sections
layout.alignment: Strict edge-to-edge alignment with high contrast borders
rules: Use bold solid background blocks for visual weight distribution
Divide major sections with 3px to 6px solid #111111 rules
Incorporate circular or rectangular accent badges
